# Accepted `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` advisories (issue 8.5).
#
# One advisory ID per line (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx, or whatever identifier
# `pnpm audit`'s JSON surfaces for it - see .github/scripts/check-audit-allowlist.py).
# Every entry MUST have a comment explaining why it's accepted (no fix
# available, not reachable from our usage, accepted risk with an owner and
# a re-review date) - never add an entry just to make CI green.
#

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reviewed 2026-08-08, when Stellar Wallets Kit was added for issue 5.1.
#
# Every advisory below is in a dependency of a wallet module this app does NOT
# import. The kit declares all its integrations as hard dependencies, so Trezor
# (-> @trezor/connect -> protobufjs) and the HOT wallet SDK (-> @solana/web3.js
# -> jayson -> uuid, and -> @near-js/crypto -> secp256k1 -> elliptic) are
# installed, but `apps/web/lib/wallet.ts` imports only the six browser-extension
# modules by subpath, so none of this is bundled or executed.
#
# Verified, not assumed: `scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs` greps the built
# client chunks for these packages and fails if any appears. It runs in CI after
# the web build, so the moment someone imports modules/trezor these entries stop
# being true AND the build goes red — rather than the allowlist quietly
# continuing to vouch for them.
#
# Re-review: when Wallets Kit is next upgraded, or if the guard is removed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
